for.en: People who own their home: the house, what's in it, your liability, and somewhere to stay during repairs
for.zh: 自有房屋的人：保房子本身、屋內財物、你的責任，和修繕期間的暫住

questions.en: What's the home's ZIP code? (or city and state)
questions.zh: 房子的郵遞區號？（或城市和州）

questions.en: How old is the home, in years?

options.zh: 鋼筋混凝土或鋼構（公寓大樓）

questions.en: What would it cost to rebuild the home? (not the land; about $200 a square foot if unsure)
questions.zh: 重建房子要多少錢？（不含土地；不確定可用每平方英尺 200 美元估）

questions.en: What would replacing what's inside cost?
questions.zh: 屋內財物重買要多少錢？

questions.en: Home claims in the last three years?
questions.zh: 過去三年申請過幾次房屋理賠？

coverages.en: The home itself (fire, wildfire, windstorm and hurricane, hail, burst pipes)
coverages.zh: 房屋本身（火災、野火、風災與颶風、冰雹、水管破裂）

addons.en: Earthquake (the full home limit, fire after a quake too)
addons.zh: 地震（房屋保額 100%，含地震後火災）

addons.en: Flood (rising water, up to $250,000 for the home)
addons.zh: 洪水（含淹水，房屋最高 25 萬美元）

claims.en: Wind, hail or a hurricane damaged the roof, windows or siding
claims.zh: 風災、冰雹或颶風打壞屋頂、門窗或外牆

claims.en: A burst pipe damaged the home
claims.zh: 水管破裂造成屋內損壞

claims.en: Water from my home damaged a neighbor's
claims.zh: 我家漏水弄壞鄰居的房子

claims.en: We can't live there during repairs

clauses.en: "The home" is the dwelling at the insured address and what is attached to it: walls, roof, built-in appliances, plumbing, wiring, and an attached garage. In a condo, the unit and its improvements only; the association insures the building.
clauses.zh: 「房屋」指承保地址的住宅及其附屬部分：牆、屋頂、內建家電、水電管線和相連車庫。公寓大樓只保你的單位及裝修，建築本體由管委會投保。

clauses.en: "Rebuild cost" is what rebuilding or repairing the home in similar materials costs. The home is paid at rebuild cost, up to the home limit.
clauses.zh: 「重建成本」指以同等材質重建或修復房屋所需的費用。房屋依重建成本理賠，以房屋保額為上限。

clauses.en: When the home is damaged by fire, wildfire, lightning, explosion, windstorm (hurricanes included), hail, a burst pipe or a vehicle, we pay to repair or rebuild it, less the deductible. Flood and earthquake are covered only with HO-5.3 and HO-5.1.
clauses.zh: 房屋因火災、野火、雷擊、爆炸、風災（含颶風）、冰雹、水管破裂或車輛撞擊而毀損時，我們支付修復或重建費用，扣除自負額。洪水與地震須加保 HO-5.3、HO-5.1 才理賠。

clauses.en: What's inside, damaged or lost through an HO-2.1 event or theft, is paid at replacement cost less the deductible. Report a theft to the police within 24 hours. A single item over $1,500 not listed under HO-5.2 is paid up to $1,500.
clauses.zh: 屋內財物因 HO-2.1 所列事故或竊盜而毀損或滅失，依重置成本扣除自負額理賠。竊盜須於 24 小時內報警。單件超過 1,500 美元而未依 HO-5.2 加保者，以 1,500 美元為上限。

clauses.en: When you are legally liable to someone else through owning or looking after the home, we pay, up to $300,000 per occurrence, and defend you. Don't admit liability or settle without our agreement.
clauses.zh: 你因所有或管理承保房屋，對第三人負損害賠償責任時，我們代為賠償並為你抗辯，每一事故最高 30 萬美元。未經同意請勿承認責任或和解。

clauses.en: When an insured event makes the home unlivable, we pay to stay elsewhere, up to $200 a day and $10,000 in all, for 60 days at most.
clauses.zh: 承保事故使房屋無法居住時，我們支付暫住費用，每日最高 200 美元，合計最高 1 萬美元，最長 60 日。

clauses.en: No payment for loss caused on purpose or by fraud, by you, family living with you, or anyone acting for them.
clauses.zh: 故意行為、詐欺，或你本人、同住家人或其指使之人所造成的損失，不予理賠。

clauses.en: No payment for wear and tear, neglect, termites, mold, slow leaks, faulty workmanship, settling or sinkholes.
clauses.zh: 自然耗損、年久失修、白蟻、黴菌、逐漸滲漏、施工瑕疵、地層沉陷或天坑，不予理賠。

clauses.en: No payment for events in the first 14 days, except fire and theft; and none for a named storm already under a National Weather Service watch or warning when the policy started.
clauses.zh: 保單生效後 14 日內的事故，除火災和竊盜外，不予理賠；保單生效時美國氣象局已對該命名風暴發布監視或警報者，該風暴不予理賠。

clauses.en: No payment for war, nuclear events, government seizure, or theft and water damage while the home has been vacant for more than 60 days in a row.
clauses.zh: 戰爭、核子事故、政府徵收，以及房屋連續空置超過 60 日期間的竊盜與水損，不予理賠。

clauses.en: To claim, tell us what happened, when and where, with photos and a contractor's estimate. For losses over $5,000 we may send an adjuster; don't remove damaged parts before that, except to stop further damage.
clauses.zh: 申請理賠須提供事故經過、時間地點、照片及承包商估價。損失超過 5,000 美元時，我們可以派理賠員查勘；查勘前請勿拆除受損部分，但為防止損失擴大的必要處置除外。

clauses.en: False information or a hidden important fact lets us deny the claim and cancel the policy.
clauses.zh: 提供不實資料或隱匿重要事實者，我們得拒絕理賠並終止保單。

clauses.en: One deductible per occurrence; one hurricane, or one earthquake with its aftershocks within 72 hours, is one occurrence. A named-storm deductible of 2% of the home limit applies in hurricane-level-3 areas.
clauses.zh: 每一事故扣除一次自負額；同一颶風，或一次地震（含 72 小時內的餘震）視為一次事故。颶風等級 3 的地區，命名風暴的自負額為房屋保額的 2%。

clauses.en: Earthquake: earthquake and fire following it are paid up to the full home limit, with a deductible of 10% of the home limit.
clauses.zh: 地震：地震及地震引起之火災，以房屋保額為上限理賠，自負額為房屋保額的 10%。

clauses.en: Listed valuables are covered up to their listed amounts, loss and accidental damage too, no deductible.
clauses.zh: 貴重物品逐項列載，以列載金額為上限，含遺失與意外損壞，不扣自負額。

clauses.en: Flood: rising water from outside (rivers, storm surge, heavy rain) is paid up to $250,000 for the home and $50,000 for what's inside, after a 30-day waiting period.
clauses.zh: 洪水：外部水位上升（河川、暴潮、豪雨）造成的損失，房屋最高 25 萬美元、屋內財物最高 5 萬美元，等待期 30 日。

clauses.en: Pay monthly or yearly; a failed monthly payment has 14 days' grace, then the policy lapses until paid, and events while lapsed are not covered. Cancel any time for a refund of the days left; change any time, priced again at once.
clauses.zh: 保費月繳或年繳；月繳扣款失敗有 14 日寬限期，逾期停效，補繳後復效，停效期間的事故不予理賠。可隨時退保，按未經過日數退費；可隨時變更，立即重新計價。

clauses.en: 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee; the rest goes to the claims pool for claims and reinsurance, and what is left after the year closes goes to the cause you chose.
clauses.zh: 保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池，用於理賠與再保險；年度結算後剩餘部分捐給你所選的公益團體。
